'''Speederways''' were surface based traffic routes,<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> such as the [[City/Legends|intercity]] links that connected urban areas and industrial centers across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demar]].<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> [[Combat cloud car]]s, such as the [[Talon I combat cloud car|Talon I]], were often employed in a traffic control capacity over busy speederways.<ref name="EGVV" />
